ask: A sign-in screen for a dark desktop app called Sloperator: logo and name top-left, a centred card with Email and Password fields, a yellow (#FCC21B) Continue button, a "Forgot password?" link, and a "New here? Create an account" line under the card.

A dark settings page: a left navigation list of 6 sections with one selected; on the right a General section with 5 rows. Each row has a label, a grey description of one or two lines that has to wrap, and a control on the right (toggles, a dropdown, a text box).

A light analytics dashboard: a top bar with a title and a date range picker, 4 stat cards each with a number and a change percentage, a bar chart of 12 months with axis labels, and a table of 6 orders (id, customer, date, amount, status badge).
A phone chat screen: a header with the contact's name and avatar, 8 message bubbles of mixed length from both sides (some 3 or more lines long), timestamps, and an input bar with a send button.
